messages:
nightly-bot: nightly-evals finished: 2026-03-19 07:18Z. 12 failing prompts on redwood-open-3b-int8 (profile: int8-calib-v2). Top failure: empty/early-stop generations on summarization and instruction prompts. Full report: https://ci.internal/runs/2321 :warning:
eli: saw the spike on the dashboard, thanks. are these concentrated in any single eval set?
neha: mostly in `summarization-snoop` and `instruct-longform`. lengths >512, often system prompt + long doc. diffs show output length 0 or 1 token, sometimes a quick <EOS>.
eli: is it unique to int8-calib-v2? any fp16/fp8 diffs?
neha: fp16 baseline is fine. fp8 nightly also okay. repro seems tied to int8 profile only.
tom: I pulled a couple failing IDs and repro'd locally. command i used:
```
REPRO=tests/fixtures/failing_0123.jsonl
python -m redwood.quant.run \
  --model redwood-open-3b \
  --profile int8-calib-v2 \
  --input $REPRO \
  --max-tokens 256
```
log snippet: 
```
[INFO] loading model
[WARN] dequantize_mismatch: layer_10 -> mean diff 0.007
[DEBUG] kv_cache.init len=0
[ERROR] decode: produced <EOS> at step 1
```
neha: interesting — kv_cache.init len=0 seems wrong for long context. could be calibration not capturing longer sequence attention statistics. int8 calibration uses fixed clip thresholds per-layer; if calibration set lacks >512 tokens examples we might be underflowing scales and producing NOP tokens.
eli: do we have calibration sample distribution for int8-calib-v2?
ci-bot: profile int8-calib-v2 metadata: samples=1024, avg_len=78, p95_len=210, tags=[user-chat, short-docs]. :information_source:
tom: that explains it. the p95 is only 210, so it missed long-context dynamics. sounds like a calibration-data distribution shift.
neha: quick mitigation: roll back to int8-calib-v1 for the hosted nightlies and mark int8-calib-v2 as experimental. I'll open a rollback PR. :thumbsup:
eli: long-term fix: re-run calibration with focused long-context samples (>=1024 tokens) and include some system-instruction prefixed examples. maybe add mixed-length sampling during calib.
tom: agree. i'll produce a samples file from our long-doc corpus (estimating ~2k examples) and run a targeted calib job. planned command:
```
python -m redwood.quant.calib \
  --model redwood-open-3b \
  --out int8-calib-v3 \
  --samples corpus/long_docs_2k.jsonl \
  --clip-method per_channel
```
neha: schedule: run calib tonight (low-prio infra window), then smoke on those 12 failing IDs + 1k random long prompts. if green, promote to staged canary.
eli: also add a tiny eval check in nightly pipeline: if any int8 eval has median output length < 0.5x fp16 median for same set, fail early and attach sample diffs.
ci-bot: ticket created: https://issues.internal/RED-ML-4598 assigned to @tom, priority P1 for rollback/regression.
eli: thanks all. can someone post the rollback PR link when created?
neha: will do, rolling back now.
nightly-bot: noted: replaced int8-calib-v2 -> int8-calib-v1 for next run. monitoring for regressions. :eyes:
